mapper.insert: INSERT INTO retail_price_sync_runs (matched_count, applied_count, skipped_count, remark, rollback_of_run_id) VALUES (#{matchedCount}, #{appliedCount}, #{skippedCount}, #{remark}, #{rollbackOfRunId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM retail_price_sync_runs WHERE rollback_of_run_id = #{runId}

SELECT id, matched_count, applied_count, skipped_count, remark, rollback_of_run_id, created_at FROM retail_price_sync_runs ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
